# Data & Tools

We are developing a wide range of community tools and apps for ecosystem modelers and policy end-users of our simulation data.
Please check our [Terms of Use](https://www.isimip.org/gettingstarted/terms-of-use/){target="_blank"} (via ISIMIP) if you would like to use these data for peer-reviewed research.

## FishMIP Apps for Data Exploration

-   [Country-level Ensemble Model Outputs](https://fishmip.global-ecosystem-model.cloud.edu.au/shiny/FAO_report_shiny/){target="_blank"}:
Check out our Shinyapp (beta version) to visualise spatially aggregated data of projected changes in potential fish biomass, under alternative climate emission scenarios.

-   [Input Explorer for Regional Modellers](https://fishmip.global-ecosystem-model.cloud.edu.au/shiny/FishMIP_Input_Explorer/){target="_blank"}:
Examine inputs per regional ecosystem model domain.

-   [Southern Ocean Projections Explorer](https://fishmip.global-ecosystem-model.cloud.edu.au/shiny/ACEAS_legacy_app/){target="_blank"}: Explore mean changes in marine biomass estimated by the FishMIP ensemble (including 10 marine ecosystem models) relative to the reference period (2005-2014) for Antarctic waters.


## Tutorials

R/Python tutorials for extracting data from ISIMIP servers, regional-scale model inputs from global gridded Earth System Models, or plotting outputs from FishMIP, using a regional shapefiles.

-   [Accessing ISIMIP data](https://github.com/Fish-MIP/FishMIP_NOAA_workshop/blob/main/scripts/Accessing_climate_data_ISIMIP.md){target="_blank"}

-   [Creating regional model maps from shapefiles](https://github.com/Fish-MIP/FishMIP_regions){target="_blank"}

-   [Extracting data using regional mask](https://github.com/Fish-MIP/FishMIP_extracting-data/blob/main/Scripts/Extracting_FishMIP_data.md){target="_blank"}

:::
